source_title: Solo Leveling Season 3 Officially Announced In New Update
source_excerpt:
Solo Leveling stands tall as one of the most recognizable anime series all around the world. When it comes specifically to South Korean series, it is by far the most popular, and it has redefined the genre as a whole and inspired many others to follow its lead.
This new rise in popularity for Sung Jinwoo's story comes from the TV anime by Aniplex and A-1 Pictures, but its first project that got traction was, of course, its manhwa. While Sung Jinwoo's manhwa series ended in 2020, Solo Leveling continues with the manhwa adaptation of his son's journey, known as Solo Leveling: Ragnarok . As many fans know, Solo Leveling: Ragnarok went on a sudden hiatus back in January 2026 . The wait has been long since then, but finally, after 10 months, we have official confirmation that Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Season 3, the next installment of the sequel, is on the way. The new artist Sanjimseung is finally ready to continue from where the previous artist, JIN, left off back in January.
Solo Leveling Ragnarok Season 3 Is Officially Returning With New Artist Soon
Fans all over the world know Solo Leveling as Sung Jinwoo's story first and foremost. However, Jinwoo's journey came to an end as a novel in 2018 and as a Manhwa in 2020. That said, the Solo Leveling universe is still expanding through the sequel that follows his son, Sung Suho, known as Solo Leveling Ragnarok. This new series is nowhere near as popular as the original story, especially due to no anime adaptation out at the moment. With that being said, Solo Leveling: Ragnarok is still an exciting piece of media that fans have grown to love, as it expands the Solo Leveling universe and introduces new, exciting characters and even brings back beloved fan favorites.
Unfortunately for fans of Solo Leveling: Ragnarok, the series went on a sudden hiatus earlier this year, on January 7, 2026, after the release of Chapter 68, which concluded what is officially referred to as Solo Leveling Ragnarok Season 2. The manhwa went on a sudden break because of the artist JIN, who had taken a sudden leave due to military enlistment. In a message posted on January 7, 2026, Jin revealed that he is unable to continue drawing for the Solo Leveling: Ragnarok manhwa because of his mandatory enlistment in the South Korean army. He did state, however, that a new artist had already been chosen, one of DUBU’s former apprentices, to continue on the legacy he left behind.
Ever since then, we didn't receive any new updates and had no idea who this new artist would be. Finally, new information pertaining to the project is officially out. On October 28, 2026, the new cover for Solo Leveling: Ragnarok was made public. This new cover sees Sung Suho take the spotlight and showcases the art style of the new artist, who we now know as Sanjimseung, thanks to the D&C credits.
Fans familiar with the medium might recognize this artist as the illustrator for Ice Lord, another popular manhwa series. His art is definitely distinct from Solo Leveling’s previous illustrator Jin, but it shines in its own unique way. It's hard to tell how the Manhwa art will be, but the cover itself looks promising. This confirms Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Season 3 is officially coming.
Unfortunately, at the moment, we still don't have an exact return date for Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Season 3, which will continue with the release of Chapter 69, picking things back up from where Jin left off. With a new cover unveiled, we will see the return of Solo Leveling: Ragnarok Season 3 sometime in the upcoming weeks.
What To Expect From Solo Leveling Ragnarok Season 3
Solo Leveling Ragnarok Season 3's return is big news for the community as a whole. Since the series went on break in January 2026 all the way up to its presumed return in the next few weeks, the manhwa will have been on hiatus for at least 10 long months, which is quite a long time with no new Solo Leveling content for the fans.
Given that the break has been quite long, fans might not have any idea what to expect from the upcoming arc being illustrated by Sanjimseung in the new Solo Leveling Ragnarok season. For context, as previously stated, Jin's work stopped at Solo Leveling Ragnarok Chapter 68, while Sanjimseung will start illustrating from chapter 69 onwards.
When it comes to recent Manhwa events in Ragnarok, Jin's work concluded with Suho's confrontation against the descendants of some of the Monarchs, namely the descendants of the Monarch of Plague, the Monarch of Transfiguration, and the Monarch of the Beginning. Suho, with the help of Esil and Grey, joins the battle, and a huge confrontation erupts with high stakes and exciting action.
This heated battle hasn't yet ended. In other words, in Sanjimseung’s new chapters, we will see the full confrontation unfold, and after that, Sung Suho's greater struggle against the Itarim will be put on full display. There is still a lot of content for Sanjimseung to adapt from the novel, which means we are likely to see a lot of new chapters illustrated by them over the next couple of months. Most likely, Sanjimseung will go on to handle the franchise from here onwards, and adapt the rest of the novel over more seasons after Season 3.

Sung Jinwoo’s Own Season 3 Seems Unlikely With Movie On The Way
Solo Leveling Ragnarok Season 3 is going to be an exciting addition to the manhwa collection of the franchise, featuring new, exciting battles and chapters focusing on Sung Suho's journey. However, most fans of Solo Leveling still care first and foremost about the original main character of the series, Sung Jinwoo, and his own journey.
Unfortunately, Jinwoo has no more novel or manhwa content to play an active role in, with his story having concluded already in 2018 in the novel and 2020 in the manhwa. The only thing we are looking forward to right now is the Solo Leveling anime. It has been officially confirmed that Solo Leveling Season 3 isn't coming immediately after the second season.
Instead, the franchise is doing a movie release that is set to adapt the next arcs after Jeju Island, called Solo Leveling: Beyond The System . This new Solo Leveling movie is set to adapt the Ahjin Guild arc and the Return to the Double Dungeon arc, two of the most exciting parts of the story. In other words, Solo Leveling Season 3 isn't happening for now. If successful, it is possible that Solo Leveling will instead switch entirely to movie releases instead of doing anime seasons , but no confirmation on that end has been given to us just yet.
